title: Mcp Boilerplate

readmeExtract: MCP Boilerplate: Simple Setup Guide This project helps you create your own remote MCP server on Cloudflare with user login and payment options. You don't need to be a technical expert to get it running. [!NOTE] This project is now free to use and open source. If you want to support me, just follow me on X [@iannuttall](https://x.com/iannuttall) and subscribe to [my newsletter](https://ian.is). What You'll Get An MCP
